summary: PB-05 analyzes the final updates to Agents.md (commit 7cf2f4c), the introduction of dependency-map.json (commit b899191), the GitHub Actions dependency-sync workflow (commit 7839cfd), and the live-ground-truth-verification skill documentation (commit 12f457d). Key evolutions include formalizing the shared_configuration_contract (config.json), integrating step-3-evaluation.json via external_files.step3_evaluation_artifact (updating test count to 31), embedding live ground truth checks across all steps, establishing a maintenance workflow for file synchronization using GeminiEvaluation, and documenting the live-ground-truth-verification protocol.

facts.statement: In commit 7cf2f4c (2026-10-01T14:05:38-07:00), Agents.md added rule 'shared_configuration_contract_governs_external_references', specifying that all external file dependencies, triggers, runtime roots, and evaluation artifacts must be declared in ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/config.json.

In commit 7cf2f4c, the Step 3 execution_return_schema in Agents.md updated Test_Count from 1 to 31, and Step 3 supervisory gate instructions updated references to resolve the canonical evaluation artifact from config.json (external_files.step3_evaluation_artifact).

Commit 7cf2f4c replaced runtime requirement 'step_3_test_source_remains_available' with 'step_3_evaluation_artifact_is_canonical', requiring that step3_evaluation_artifact provide both evaluation_heuristic and complete Step3_TSR question corpus as one parsed JSON object without read-tracking fields.

Commit b899191 (2026-10-01T17:09:24-07:00) added ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/dependency-map.json, defining mappings between Agents.md and send-to-gemini.js with mutual dependents and shared context ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/tests/step-3-evaluation.json, guarded by sentinel ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/dependency-sync-sentinel.json.

Commit 7839cfd (2026-10-01T17:11:49-07:00) added .github/workflows/gemini-supervisor-dependency-sync.yml, triggered on push to main modifying Agents.md or send-to-gemini.js, which runs GeminiEvaluation with generic evaluation mode to replace mapped dependent files when the sentinel enabled flag is true.

Commit 12f457d (2026-09-30T19:07:24-07:00) added ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/skills/live-ground-truth-verification/SKILL.md, defining the live-ground-truth-verification procedure, semantic triggers, ground-truth taxonomy, and classification statuses (VERIFIED, CONTRADICTED, PARTIAL, UNKNOWN, NOT EXECUTED).

interpretations.description: Agents.md transitioned from referencing an external markdown test file (evaluation-tests.md) with an earlier count of 32 down to a single test placeholder (1) in intermediary drafts, and finally settling on 31 tests defined inside a unified JSON evaluation artifact (step-3-evaluation.json) referenced via config.json.

The dependency sync workflow (.github/workflows/gemini-supervisor-dependency-sync.yml) is a CI maintenance automation mechanism that invokes GeminiEvaluation to enforce bidirectional alignment between Agents.md and send-to-gemini.js, rather than part of the user-facing Step 0-4 execution flow.

The skill file SKILL.md represents guideline/specification documentation for ground-truth verification behavior; runtime enforcement in send-to-gemini.js is deterministic via collectGroundTruth, validateStep, and gate evaluation structures rather than relying on LLM skill obedience alone.

truth_decisions.claim: Agents.md external dependency references must strictly use config.json keys and not hardcode external paths.
truth_decisions.rationale: Explicitly added as rule 'shared_configuration_contract_governs_external_references' and runtime integration requirement 'shared_configuration_contract' in commit 7cf2f4c.

truth_decisions.claim: Evaluation definitions must be maintained in external evaluator-definitions.md.
truth_decisions.rationale: Explicitly superseded and forbidden by Agents.md rule 'agents_md_is_canonical_evaluation_source', which mandates that all evaluation definitions and criteria reside in Agents.md.

truth_decisions.claim: The dependency sync workflow runs unconditionally on every push modifying Agents.md or send-to-gemini.js.
truth_decisions.rationale: Workflow execution requires sentinel enabled === true in dependency-sync-sentinel.json and exactly one mapped base file modified.

requirement_candidates.name: Shared Configuration Contract
requirement_candidates.statement: All external file dependencies, triggers, runtime roots, and evaluation artifacts must be resolved via keys in ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/config.json rather than hardcoded in Agents.md or runtime code.

requirement_candidates.name: Step 3 Test Count and Canonical JSON Artifact
requirement_candidates.statement: Step 3 evaluation must evaluate exactly 31 tests provided by the unified JSON artifact step-3-evaluation.json (referenced via config.json key external_files.step3_evaluation_artifact) containing both evaluation_heuristic and step3_tsr.

requirement_candidates.name: Live Ground Truth Verification Schema & Determinism
requirement_candidates.statement: Deterministic live ground truth findings must be collected prior to Gemini supervisory evaluation and embedded in ground_truth_verification_eval, classifying execution claims as VERIFIED, CONTRADICTED, PARTIAL, UNKNOWN, or NOT_EXECUTED, blocking PASS if material claims fail.

requirement_candidates.name: Evaluator Definition File Read-Tracking
requirement_candidates.statement: Procedure returns must track reading evaluator-definitions.md via evaluation_documents_read.

requirement_candidates.name: Dependency Map Maintenance Synchronization
requirement_candidates.statement: Automated synchronization via gemini-supervisor-dependency-sync.yml must maintain mutual alignment between Agents.md and send-to-gemini.js according to dependency-map.json when triggered and enabled by sentinel.

implementation_findings.description: Agents.md fully specifies rules, schemas, dependency charts, and runtime integration requirements for shared configuration, 31-count Step 3 tests, and live ground truth verification.

Maps ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/Agents.md and send-to-gemini.js as mutual dependents with step-3-evaluation.json as read-only context, designating dependency-sync-sentinel.json as control sentinel.

Deterministic bash and Node.js steps inspect git diff, verify single-file trigger constraint, check sentinel status, invoke evaluate-supervisor.js, and strictly validate the returned dependency_alignment JSON before committing file updates.
SKILL.md defines behavioral guidelines and semantic trigger conditions for models but lacks executable enforcement mechanisms in this file itself.

unresolved.question: Is dependency-sync-sentinel.json enabled in the working tree, and are Agents.md and send-to-gemini.js currently in full alignment regarding the shared configuration contract and 31 test count?
unresolved.reason: PB-05 contains the patch logs for Agents.md, dependency-map.json, dependency sync workflow, and SKILL.md, but does not include the raw current content of send-to-gemini.js, config.json, or dependency-sync-sentinel.json.
